title: [PM seat] repo:cloud · seat 2 — ⏳ vacant
body:
**This post is the registration of `repo:cloud` seat 2** (`Seat: repo:cloud#2`). Seat 1's post is objectstack-ai/objectstack#6026 (`⏳ vacant` since its brief `6229798294`); it carries the lane's platform facts, the standing bans and the permanent notes, and this post does not copy them. Seat-post protocol: index = `label:pm:seat`; only the sitting PM edits this body; takeover or handover = body edit + audit comment; re-fetch before editing, first stamp wins, read back after writing.

## 当前 PM

**⏳ vacant.** R4 (`os-zhuang`, session `session_01Cbdek8SKSHxddGqTPZXdqX`, seat `repo:cloud#2`) stood down on the maintainer's word in chat, 「当前任务处理完，合并后就下班」 (2026-10-20, about 02:15Z). The stand-down time is the stamp on the brief comment posted right after this edit (body refreshed 2026-10-20T02:50Z). The patrol scheduled task `trig_018991kMvwJ5KBdCBY9M9SCS` is removed. Successor: `/pm-dispatch 接手`, after reading this post and the brief.
- **Stay-behind: none.** No `os-dev` of this seat is running, and no PR of this seat is open. The last tail, PR #3093 (cloud#3081), merged as `a46db00b`. `check-handover.mjs` exited 0 for this session on objectstack-ai/cloud and objectstack-ai/objectui.
- **Lane rules at stand-down** (the maintainer's words to this seat, still in force):
  - one dev at a time (「当前任务处理完，后续并发降到1」);
  - p1/p2 only (「后续只处理 p1 p2 的任务」);
  - the seat closes a lane card whose written close condition is met (「2822这种你应该负责关闭」);
  - an approved governed PR whose approval sits on its current head, with green checks, is queued by the seat with a landing note (「2886 我已经批准了，你帮我判断入队」);
  - the cards once assigned to `hotlong` are this lane's (「hotlong的任务你都接手」).
- **The framework pin is frozen** at `fb9c22aa`. The maintainer's ruling, quoted in PR #3088 (2026-10-20): 「框架 pin 留在 fb9c22aa，只把 objectui 抬到最新……等 objectstack#24580 合并后再抬框架」.
  - **Why:** every framework the current objectui console needs carries objectstack-ai/objectstack#24480's walled-boot refusal (cloud#2914 rounds 8–9).
  - **Order once objectstack-ai/objectstack#24580 merges:**
    1. The framework move (cloud#3053). It crosses `29d0ed33`, so cloud#3086's `change_slug` declaration lands first or rides along.
    2. The objectui move (cloud#2914).
    3. cloud#3036 (re-land PR #3040's change), #2924 and #3002.
- **Decision box:**
  - cloud#3087: the environment card's title. The seat recommends A, the name on both pages.
  - cloud#3092: `change_plan` as a sales path. The seat recommends A, offline orders. It needs the maintainer's production count.
- **The maintainer's staging looks:** cloud#3072 (「帮我分析一下客户」) and cloud#2914 Acceptance 2 (the splash). cloud#3074 is the ops seat's (`hotlong`).
- **objectstack-ai/objectui cards this seat dispatched:** #12724 is `pm:blocked`; #12725 is `pm:awaiting-maintainer`.
- **Branch leftovers:**
  - `claude/issue-2914-objectui-pin` (PR #3067's branch, merged, never deleted; its tip `b4ca5ef9` is not on `main`). A fresh round takes a new branch name.
  - `claude/issue-2914-objectui-pin-r8` and `claude/issue-2914-pins-r9` sit empty at `295d7a76`.
- **Tooling note:** the relay's re-exec notice prints the proxy variable's value, a local address and not a credential. Quote relay output without that line.

## 继承台账

Queue snapshot at this edit (REST, `state=open`, one read per label):
- `pm:queue` 7: #3086 (p2); #3089 (cloud `AGENTS.md` item 12, Tier H), #3016, #3006, #3000, #2950, #2988 (p3; #2988 `pm:retriage`).
- `needs-user-decision` 2: #3087, #3092.
- `pm:blocked` 8: #3053, #2914 (p1, on objectstack-ai/objectstack#24580); #1979 (p1, on objectstack-ai/objectstack#24343); #3036, #3002, #2924 (p2, on objectstack-ai/objectstack#24580); #2927 (p2, on #2924); #2913 (p2, on #3087).
- `pm:awaiting-maintainer` 8: #3074 (the ops seat's), #3072, #2767, #2549, #2377, #2274, #1765, #786.
- `pm:dispatched` 0.
- `pm:on-hold` 5: #2546, #2512, #2367, #2310, #1288. In objectstack-ai/objectui this seat holds #12725 and #12724 (`pm:blocked`). Other objectui cards are left to the objectui seats. ⛔ This post lists no inherited rulings.

## 热文件串行队

Serial order:
- **`service-ai-studio`** `src/skills/data-explorer-skill.ts`: free since PR #3076.
- **`service-cloud`** `routes/environment-lifecycle.ts`, `routes/billing-order.ts`, `billing.ts`: free since PR #3093 (`a46db00b`).
- **`service-tenant`** `sys-environment.object.ts`: free since the revert (`eb534b82`). The re-land waits for cloud#3036's two upstreams.
- **The pin files:**
  - `.objectstack-sha`: `fb9c22aa0929` (PR #3071), **frozen** until objectstack-ai/objectstack#24580 (the maintainer's ruling quoted in PR #3088). The move past `29d0ed33` carries cloud#3086's `change_slug` declaration, or follows its landing. It does not yet carry objectstack-ai/objectstack#24410 (`45bec43cd9`): at the next move, a formula reading an undeclared related field answers `422` at save (the `domain:engine` seat's pointer `6262663077`). The blueprint and `apply_blueprint` paths are the readers to check.
  - `.objectui-sha`: `cc4ae3e144e3` (PR #3088, `hotlong`). It is the newest objectui that builds at `fb9c22aa`. The next move needs framework `ca426cb6` or later, so it waits on objectstack-ai/objectstack#24580.
- **`packages/objectos-runtime`:** free.
- **Riders:** at the framework pin bump that carries objectstack-ai/objectstack#24377 Q1 A (cloud#3051's reading `6258001191`), `apps/cloud/test/unscoped-control-plane-tenant-wall.test.ts:2453-2455` re-pins `platformScopeSets` to `[]` (and `:2475-2476` if the settle seam fires on the test's direct `sys_member` insert); at the next framework pin move that carries objectstack-ai/objectstack#24412 (pointer `6257439197`), cloud#2912's booted test expects the caller's role to read `owner` after `transfer_ownership` (not `admin`), and any copy it asserts reads 「Make Owner」; the stale lock-mark comment in `environment-lifecycle.ts` rides the next cloud PR that edits that file; `.spec-changes-ack.json`'s four view-filter rows (they name the removed `PlanBlueprintViewSchema`) ride the next PR that edits them.

Every cloud dev materialises the pin tree (`fb9c22aa` at this edit) only through `ensure-pinned-framework.mjs`, per cloud `AGENTS.md` item 12 (`8b34956e`). Every build, test and stack still goes through the verify lock, as `os-dev.md` 资源纪律 1 says; the gap between that and item 12's wording is objectstack-ai/objectstack#24525.

## 说明

- Scope: the `objectstack-ai/cloud` whole-repo queue, as seat 1's 范围 section states; ⛔ no `domain:*` is produced here. `references/lanes/cloud.md` still does not exist.
- ⚠️ Linked-user deviation, recorded: the linked user `os-zhuang` is in `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`; writes went through the relay as `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, and no approving review was submitted from this seat.
- Mode deviation, recorded: every dispatch ran `mode:subagent`, including R3's `L` fold (the frozen pin tree and the verify lock were in the seat's container; the cloud backend's push path for this lane was not verified from it).
- Platform readings, this shift: `post-stamped.mjs` takes `--repo=owner/name` with an equals sign; a quoted stamp inside a stamped body is spelled `{{WAS:…}}`; a decision analysis is refused without its `os-decision-facets` block; `close-cards.mjs` refuses a card with an assignee and needs `--expect-state` naming the current state; the MCP semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui answered zero even for a control naming objectui#12294 (use REST enumeration); the merge queue lands two PRs within a minute of each other; a body refresh on a card whose body carries no stamp is refused until `--ack-through=ID` names the newest comment. Converting a queued PR to draft does not take it out of a merge group that is already building: PR #3040 merged 5 minutes after the seat's `automerge_disable` + `pr_draft`. The relay has no dequeue, so a hold on a queued PR is the maintainer's 「Remove from queue」 click.
